description: Declaration form filled by the employee at the time of joining a new establishment. Used to check if the employee is an existing EPF member and to auto-transfer old PF.

fields.name: Employee Name
fields.description: Your full name as it appears on your Aadhaar card or passport.

fields.name: Father's Name / Spouse's Name
fields.description: Father's name for unmarried individuals; husband's/wife's name for married persons.

fields.name: Date of Birth
fields.description: DD/MM/YYYY format. Must match your Aadhaar card.

fields.name: Marital Status
fields.description: Married / Unmarried — this determines which family members are eligible nominees.

fields.name: Mobile Number
fields.description: Your active mobile number registered with Aadhaar (for UAN activation OTP).

fields.name: Email ID
fields.description: Email address for EPFO portal login and communication.

fields.name: Aadhaar Number
fields.description: Your 12-digit Aadhaar number — mandatory for UAN seeding and KYC.

fields.name: PAN
fields.description: Your PAN — required if monthly PF contribution is above ₹833 (to avoid higher TDS).

fields.name: Previous PF Account Number
fields.description: If you were a member of EPF before, enter the old PF account number here.

fields.name: Previous UAN
fields.description: If you already have a Universal Account Number, enter it — do NOT create a new one.

fields.name: Name of Previous Employer
fields.description: Name of the company where you previously worked and had a PF account.

fields.name: Date of Leaving Previous Employer
fields.description: The date on which you left your previous job (for PF transfer calculation).

fields.name: Whether International Worker
fields.description: Select Yes if you are a foreign national or Indian working abroad on assignment.

fields.name: Bank Account Number
fields.description: Bank account number to be linked for PF withdrawals.

fields.name: IFSC Code
fields.description: IFSC code of your bank branch.

fields.name: Employee Signature with Date
fields.description: Sign here confirming that all information is accurate and complete.
